targets.rawSql: SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(timestamp) AS time_sec, COUNT(*) AS count FROM (SELECT timestamp FROM web_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT timestamp FROM rtsp_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT timestamp FROM onvif_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT timestamp FROM cowrie_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) AS combined_logs GROUP BY time_sec ORDER BY time_sec ASC;

SELECT ip_address AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT ip_address FROM web_service_logs WHERE ip_address IS NOT NULL AND ip_address <> '' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT ip_address FROM rtsp_service_logs WHERE ip_address IS NOT NULL AND ip_address <> '' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT ip_address FROM onvif_service_logs WHERE ip_address IS NOT NULL AND ip_address <> '' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT ip_address FROM cowrie_service_logs WHERE ip_address IS NOT NULL AND ip_address <> '' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)) AS combined_ips GROUP BY ip_address ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT NOW() AS time, 'Web Service' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM web_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT NOW() AS time, 'RTSP Service' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM rtsp_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT NOW() AS time, 'ONVIF Service' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM onvif_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT NOW() AS time, 'Cowrie Service' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM cowrie_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp);

SELECT NOW() AS time, brand AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT brand FROM web_service_logs WHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand NOT IN ('auto', 'test', '8080', '8088', '8086', '8087', '8089', '8090', 'curl/8.14.1') AND brand REGEXP '^[a-zA-Z]+$' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT brand FROM rtsp_service_logs WHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand NOT IN ('auto', 'test', '8080', '8088', '8086', '8087', '8089', '8090', 'curl/8.14.1') AND brand REGEXP '^[a-zA-Z]+$' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT brand FROM onvif_service_logs WHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand NOT IN ('auto', 'test', '8080', '8088', '8086', '8087', '8089', '8090', 'curl/8.14.1') AND brand REGEXP '^[a-zA-Z]+$' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT brand FROM cowrie_service_logs WHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand NOT IN ('auto', 'test', '8080', '8088', '8086', '8087', '8089', '8090', 'curl/8.14.1') AND brand REGEXP '^[a-zA-Z]+$' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)) AS combined_brands GROUP BY brand;

SELECT country AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ip_reputation WHERE country IS NOT NULL AND ip_address NOT IN ('172.18.0.1', '::ffff:172.18.0.1', '127.0.0.1', '::1', 'localhost') GROUP BY country ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT country AS location, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ip_reputation WHERE country IS NOT NULL AND ip_address NOT IN ('172.18.0.1', '::ffff:172.18.0.1', '127.0.0.1', '::1', 'localhost') GROUP BY country;

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(hour_bucket) AS time_sec, COUNT(*) AS web_connections FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS hour_bucket FROM web_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) AS subquery GROUP BY hour_bucket ORDER BY time_sec ASC;

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(hour_bucket) AS time_sec, COUNT(*) AS rtsp_connections FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS hour_bucket FROM rtsp_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) AS subquery GROUP BY hour_bucket ORDER BY time_sec ASC;

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(hour_bucket) AS time_sec, COUNT(*) AS onvif_connections FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS hour_bucket FROM onvif_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) AS subquery GROUP BY hour_bucket ORDER BY time_sec ASC;

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(hour_bucket) AS time_sec, COUNT(*) AS cowrie_connections FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS hour_bucket FROM cowrie_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) AS subquery GROUP BY hour_bucket ORDER BY time_sec ASC;

panels.title: Web Service Payloads - HTTP Requests & Responses

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  timestamp,
  event_type,
  ip_address,
  brand,
  username,
  COALESCE(request_path, 'No path') as request_path,
  COALESCE(request_method, 'No method') as request_method,
  COALESCE(response_code, 'No code') as response_code,
  CASE 
    WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.request') IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.request')
    ELSE 'No request data' 
  END as request_data,
  CASE 
    WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.response') IS NOT NULL THEN LEFT(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.response'), 200) 
    ELSE 'No response data' 
  END as response_data,
  message
FROM web_service_logs 
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC 
LIMIT 100;

panels.title: RTSP Service Payloads - Stream & Connection Data

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  timestamp,
  event_type,
  ip_address,
  brand,
  username,
  password,
  COALESCE(rtsp_method, 'No method') as rtsp_method,
  COALESCE(stream_path, 'No path') as stream_path,
  COALESCE(connection_id, 'No ID') as connection_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN payload IS NOT NULL AND JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.request') IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.request')
    ELSE 'No request data' 
  END as request_data,
  CASE 
    WHEN payload IS NOT NULL AND JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.response') IS NOT NULL THEN LEFT(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.response'), 200) 
    ELSE 'No response data' 
  END as response_data,
  message
FROM rtsp_service_logs 
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC 
LIMIT 100;

panels.title: ONVIF Service Payloads - SOAP & Service Events

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  timestamp,
  event_type,
  ip_address,
  brand,
  COALESCE(soap_action, JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.request_headers.soapaction')) as soap_action,
  COALESCE(request_method, JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.method')) as request_method,
  COALESCE(request_url, JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.url')) as request_url,
  COALESCE(response_status, JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.status_code')) as response_status,
  LEFT(raw_data, 300) as raw_data_preview,
  message
FROM onvif_service_logs 
WHERE timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC 
LIMIT 150;

panels.title: Cowrie Service Detailed Payloads - Filtered by Event Type

targets.rawSql:
WITH deduplicated_commands AS (
  SELECT 
    timestamp,
    event_type,
    ip_address,
    brand,
    username,
    COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.input'), JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.command'), command, 'No command') as command,
    COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.outfile'), JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.filename'), file_path, 'No path') as file_path,
    COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.size'), file_size, 'No size') as file_size,
    CASE 
      WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.session') IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_OBJECT('session_id', JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.session'), 'duration', JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.duration'), 'ttylog', JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.ttylog'), 'sensor', JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.sensor'))
      WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.session_data') IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.session_data')
      WHEN session_id IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_OBJECT('session_id', session_id, 'duration', 'N/A', 'ttylog', 'N/A', 'sensor', 'N/A')
      ELSE 'No session data' 
    END as session_data,
    CASE 
      WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.ttylog') IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('TTY Log: ', JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.ttylog'), ' (', COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.size'), file_size, 'unknown'), ' bytes)')
      WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.command_output') IS NOT NULL THEN LEFT(JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.command_output'), 200)
      ELSE 'No command output' 
  END as command_output,
    message,
    JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.session') as session_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY 
        JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.input'), 
        JSON_EXTRACT(raw_data, '$.session'), 
        ip_address, 
        timestamp
      ORDER BY id ASC
    ) as rn
  FROM cowrie_service_logs 
  WHERE raw_data IS NOT NULL AND (
    event_type = 'session_start' OR 
    event_type = 'session_end' OR 
    event_type = 'login_success' OR 
    event_type = 'auth_failure' OR 
    event_type = 'command_execution' OR 
    event_type = 'download_attempt' OR 
    event_type = 'upload_attempt' OR 
    event_type = 'service_event'
  ) AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
)
SELECT 
  timestamp,
  event_type,
  ip_address,
  brand,
  username,
  command,
  file_path,
  file_size,
  session_data,
  command_output,
  message
FROM deduplicated_commands 
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY timestamp DESC 
LIMIT 100;

SELECT timestamp, 'web' AS service, event_type, COALESCE(ip_address, 'No IP') as ip_address, brand, message FROM web_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT timestamp, 'rtsp' AS service, event_type, COALESCE(ip_address, 'No IP') as ip_address, brand, message FROM rtsp_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT timestamp, 'onvif' AS service, event_type, COALESCE(ip_address, 'No IP') as ip_address, brand, message FROM onvif_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT timestamp, 'cowrie' AS service, event_type, COALESCE(ip_address, 'No IP') as ip_address, brand, message FROM cowrie_service_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
  timestamp,
  event_type,
  ip_address,
  brand,
  username,
  COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.request_path'), 'No path') as request_path,
  COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.request_method'), 'No method') as request_method,
  COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.response_code'), 'No code') as response_code,
  CASE 
    WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.request') IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.request')
    ELSE 'No request data' 
  END as request_data,
  CASE 
    WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.response') IS NOT NULL THEN LEFT(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.response'), 200) 
    ELSE 'No response data' 
  END as response_data,
  message
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp, event_type, ip_address, brand, username, payload, message FROM web_service_logs WHERE payload IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, event_type, ip_address, brand, username, payload, message FROM rtsp_service_logs WHERE payload IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, event_type, ip_address, brand, username, raw_data as payload, message FROM onvif_service_logs WHERE raw_data IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, event_type, ip_address, brand, username, raw_data as payload, message FROM cowrie_service_logs WHERE raw_data IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
) AS combined_services
ORDER BY timestamp DESC 
LIMIT 100;

SELECT username AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM (
  SELECT username FROM web_service_logs WHERE username IS NOT NULL AND username <> '' AND username <> 'null' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL

  UNION ALL
